glyph_origin: Ideogrammic compound (會意): 爪 (“hand”) + 卩 (“kneeling person”) – a hand suppressing a kneeling person. According to 羅振玉 in his book 《增訂殷墟書契考釋》(1915), the character is an ideogram of a hand suppressing a kneeling person. The character 抑 (to suppress) was used to preserve the original meaning.
